identity.name: E1
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss typography with Cyberpunk terminal aesthetics.
Data Density: Information density should be high but legible. No wasted whitespace.
Function is Beauty: The raw data (hashes, block numbers) is the art.
Dark Mode Only: This is a tool for dark rooms and multiple monitors.

typography.instructions: Import 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts. Use it for ALL headings, data values, hashes, and code blocks. Use 'Inter' only for UI labels and long-form text.

usage_rules: NEVER use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid, deep blacks.
Use the 'primary' color (Neon Mint) for 'Healthy', 'Syncing', 'Active' states.
Borders should be subtle (zinc-800) but present. 1px borders define structure.

layout.spacing: Compact. Use p-4 for cards, gap-4 for grids. This is a dashboard, not a marketing page.
layout.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, border-r border-border bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-md

cards.style: rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/40 hover:bg-card/60 transition-colors
cards.header: flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-sm font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider

status_indicators.live: h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-primary shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,153,0.6)] animate-pulse

charts.style: Minimalist. Hide grid lines if possible. Use gradients for area fills (opacity 0.2 to 0). Tooltips must be dark with neon borders.

visual_enhancers.scanlines: Add a subtle scanline overlay to 'Terminal' or 'Log' sections using CSS repeating-linear-gradient.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md for the sidebar and sticky headers. Keep opacity high (90%+) to avoid muddiness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'border-r' or 'border-b' to separate grid items instead of gaps sometimes, creating a 'spreadsheet' or 'technical' look.

assets.icons: Lucide React (already installed). Use stroke-width={1.5} for a technical feel.

images.description: Abstract geometric shapes with blue lighting for login page background

universal_guidelines: Dark Mode is the DEFAULT and ONLY mode. Do not implement a light mode toggle.
All data values (numbers, hashes, IPs) MUST be in 'JetBrains Mono'.
Interactive elements must have a 'data-testid' attribute.
Do not use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Maximum border radius is 'rounded-md' or 'rounded-sm'. Sharpness = Precision.
instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Update tailwind.config.js to include 'JetBrains Mono' as the mono font family.
3. Set the global background color to #050505 in index.css.
4. Create a 'Layout' component that includes the Sidebar and Topbar.
5. Use the 'Bento Grid' pattern for the Dashboard Overview page.
